description: Equipement de la signalisation lumineuse (DWG) is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Kanton Genf. Extraction des données de la signalisation lumineuse au format DWG. L'extraction contient les couches suivantes: numéro de carrefours, boîtes à feux, boucles, groupes de feux, détecteurs, numéro de mât, liens entre boîte à feux et mâts et armoires. Coverage: Kanton Genf. The portal files it under the publisher Kanton Genf. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
